title: Biologique Recherche’s CEO Has Exited, Sources Say
summary: Rupert Schmid and Pierre-Louis Delapalme are believed to have returned as the skin care brand’s interim chief executive officers following Jean-Guillaume Trottier's departure.

extraction.key_fact: 스킨케어 브랜드 비올로직 호셰쉬의 대표가 사임함에 따라 이전 경영진들이 임시 공동 대표로 복귀한 것으로 알려졌다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Rupert Schmid and Pierre-Louis Delapalme are believed to have returned as the skin care brand’s interim chief executive officers following Jean-Guillaume Trottier's departure.
